question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He pushed her on ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**purpose**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "on purpose" means intentionally or with a deliberate intent. (जानबूझकर)
 
• It indicates that the action was done with a specific intention.
 
• The other options: "focus," "deliberate," and "surplus" do not fit the context as appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He pushed her on purpose__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Focus (ध्यान केंद्रित करना)**: means paying particular attention to something.
 
• **Deliberate (विचारित)**: means done consciously and intentionally, but not used in this context.
 
• **Surplus (अतिरिक्त)**: means an excess of something.
